thread:
marie_finance: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off the price-sheet beta cohort next Tue. New rates live for cohort A (beta) and legacy stays for cohort B for a 90-day migration window. Link to the spreadsheet: https://redwood.ex/sheets/pricing-beta-v2 :eyes:
aj_engineering: Got it. Do we have the logic for assigning customers to A/B? random rollout or region-based?
oliver_revops: Plan was randomized by account id mod 100, 10% -> A, 90% -> B. We also need a list of exclusions (enterprise contracts + dedicated customers).
tia_billing: For billing: need to decide pro-rata rules and whether to issue one-off credits for mid-cycle price changes. Recommend pro-rate to the day and auto-apply a credit if delta > $50.
marie_finance: Agreed on pro-rate to the day. For credits, let's do auto-apply threshold of $100 to keep manual review light. Can we add a small CSV export so Billing ops can reconcile?
billing-bot: Billing export scheduled: /exports/pricing-beta-cohort-1770054321.csv will be available at 1770060000.
aj_engineering: To make the A/B stable across retries, we'll use the account-id hash approach. Pseudocode: ```
// assign cohort
if (hash(account_id) % 100 < 10) cohort = 'A' else cohort = 'B'
```
sam_sales: Heads-up: sales should be able to opt customers out of A (they can request legacy pricing opt-out). Who's the approval owner?
oliver_revops: RevOps will own opt-outs. Approval flow: sales fills form -> revops triages -> finance sign-off if > $2k MRR. I'll sketch the form today.
tia_billing: Need to handle invoices already issued for the month. If a customer moves from B->A (discount) mid-cycle, do we credit or wait until next invoice?
marie_finance: Credit immediately if delta > $100 (per above), otherwise adjust next invoice. Also update ledger with a reason code `pricing-beta-adjustment` for audit.
aj_engineering: Any rollout safety toggles needed? I can add a feature flag to flip cohort A off globally and a per-region kill switch.
marie_finance: Please add both. Also add a metric emitted to Datadog: `billing.pricing_beta.cohort_a_count` and `billing.price_change_credits_total`.
oliver_revops: Timeline: internal QA Thurs, soft launch to 10% on Tue morning, monitor 72h, then expand or rollback. Will prepare communication to AMs.
sam_sales: Can we also get a one-pager summarizing differences for AMs and renewals teams? I'll draft and share.
tia_billing: One more ops ask: include `original_rate`, `applied_rate`, `credit_amount`, `invoice_id` columns in the CSV export. That makes reconciliation straightforward.
marie_finance: Perfect. I'll update the sheet with the migration window and thresholds. If anyone sees missing edge-cases DM me. :party_parrot:
